ex.en: The property broker negotiated a lower price for the couple, earning their lasting gratitude.
ex.zh: 这位房产经纪人替那对夫妇谈下了更低的价格，赢得了他们长久的感激。

ex.en: Archaeologists unearthed bronze tools dating back three thousand years at the riverside site.
ex.zh: 考古学家在河畔遗址出土了三千年前的青铜工具。

ex.en: The editor brooks no delay: all copy must reach her desk by Friday noon.
ex.zh: 这位主编绝不容忍拖延：所有稿件必须在周五中午前送到她的桌上。

ex.en: She grabbed a broom to sweep the broken glass from the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 她抓起一把扫帚，清扫厨房地板上的碎玻璃。

ex.en: A bowl of hot chicken broth is a traditional remedy for colds in many cultures.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，一碗热鸡汤是治疗感冒的传统食疗。

senses: n. （同父母的）兄，弟；同事，伙伴

ex.en: My brother and I shared a bedroom for years, which taught us to compromise early.
ex.zh: 我和兄弟多年共用一间卧室，这让我们早早学会了妥协。

ex.en: My brother-in-law, who works as an engineer, helped us repair the leaking roof last weekend.
ex.zh: 我的姐夫是工程师，上周末帮我们修好了漏雨的屋顶。

ex.en: She raised an eyebrow at the excuse, clearly unconvinced by his explanation for arriving late.
ex.zh: 她对这个借口挑了挑眉，显然不相信他迟到的解释。

ex.en: Leaves turn brown and fall as trees withdraw nutrients to survive the cold months.
ex.zh: 随着树木回收养分以度过寒冷季节，叶子变成褐色并飘落。

senses: n. ①浏览；②嫩草，嫩叶，嫩枝，嫩芽
v. & n. （在商店里）随便看看；浏览；翻阅

ex.en: The gift shop is well worth a browse.
ex.zh: 这家礼品店很值得一看。

ex.en: Customers can browse the online store and compare prices within seconds.
ex.zh: 顾客可以浏览网上商店，几秒钟内比较价格。

ex.en: Deer browse on the young shoots in the forest every spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天鹿都会在森林里吃嫩枝嫩叶。

senses: n. [C] 浏览器；逛商店的人

ex.en: The website warns that older browsers may not display its interactive charts correctly.
ex.zh: 该网站警告说，较旧的浏览器可能无法正确显示其交互式图表。

senses: v. (使)出现伤痕；(感情)受伤害
bruise.usage: 发音类似"不如死"→她很在意自己的外表，哪怕脸上受了"擦伤"

ex.en: The apple had a small bruise on one side, so the shop sold it at half price.
ex.zh: 那个苹果一侧有小块碰伤，所以商店以半价出售。

ex.en: After a bruising debate lasting eleven hours, the bill finally passed by a narrow margin.
ex.zh: 经过长达十一小时的激烈辩论，该法案最终以微弱优势获得通过。

senses: n. 刷子，毛笔，画笔；小冲突，小摩擦
v. (用刷子)刷，(用毛笔或画笔)写，画

ex.en: Conservators used a soft brush to remove dust from the ancient manuscript page by page.
ex.zh: 文物修复人员用软刷逐页清除古代手稿上的灰尘。

senses: a. 残暴的；兽性的；冷酷的
adj. 残酷的，野蛮的，残暴的
adj. 残暴的；兽性的；冷酷的
brutal.usage: 23 "brutal"相关形近词；发音类似"布鲁特"→布鲁特是个"残暴的"人→残暴的；索引p404

ex.en: He is a brutal man.
ex.zh: 他是个残暴的人。

ex.en: The recession dealt a brutal blow to small manufacturers.
ex.zh: 经济衰退给了小型制造商残酷一击。

ex.en: Prisoners described the brutal conditions inside the overcrowded jail.
ex.zh: 囚犯们描述了这座人满为患的监狱里残酷的环境。

ex.en: His brutal honesty sometimes offends even his closest colleagues.
ex.zh: 他直白到残酷的诚实有时连最亲近的同事也会冒犯。

ex.en: Applicants should hold a BSc in chemistry or a closely related subject.
ex.zh: 申请人须持有化学或密切相关专业的理学学士学位。

senses: ②[比喻]幻想的计划，无法实现的意念、希望等
n. 泡；气泡；肥皂泡；泡沫；（好景或好运）
bubble.usage: n.气泡，泡沫，经济泡沫 v.冒泡，沸腾；涌动；发音有点像“气泡”爆炸时噼里啪啦的声音

ex.en: Economists warned of a stock-market bubble.
ex.zh: 经济学家警告说股市有泡沫。

ex.en: The housing bubble burst, leaving millions of families in negative equity.
ex.zh: 房地产泡沫破裂，使数百万家庭资不抵债。

ex.en: The children amused themselves by blowing soap bubbles in the yard.
ex.zh: 孩子们在院子里吹肥皂泡自娱。

ex.en: We could hear the soup bubbling gently on the stove.
ex.zh: 我们能听见汤在炉子上轻轻冒泡。

senses: n. 美元,澳元;雄性动物;小伙子
v. 弓背跃起;抵制,反抗

ex.en: The repairs cost several hundred bucks, but the machine now runs as well as new.
ex.zh: 修理花了几百美元，不过这台机器现在运转如新。

ex.en: Farmers carried water in buckets to the fields during the driest summer in decades.
ex.zh: 在几十年来最干旱的夏天，农民们用桶把水挑到田里。

phrases.m: 消灭在萌芽状态，防患于未然

ex.en: Gardeners prune the roses in early spring, just before the buds begin to swell.
ex.zh: 园丁在早春玫瑰芽开始膨大之前进行修剪。

ex.en: Thousands of Buddhist pilgrims travel to the mountain temple each year to meditate and pray.
ex.zh: 每年有成千上万的佛教徒前往山上的寺庙冥想祈祷。

senses: n. 预算，财政收支状况(c/u)
budget.usage: [族] budgetary a. 预算的；bud（发音类似"爸爸"）+get（得到）→爸爸得到了很多的"预算"；真题搭配：annual budget 年度预算；annual budget 年度预算；balance the budget 平衡预算。；索引p404

ex.en: He's feeling positive, but he'll carry on blogging—not about eating as cheaply as you can—but eating well on a budget.
ex.zh: 他现在心态很积极，但是他还是会继续更新博客——不是围绕尽可能吃得便宜——而是如何通过避免不必要的开支吃好。

ex.en: Today's families have budgeted to the limits of their new two-paycheck status.
ex.zh: 今天（美国）家庭的开支预算都已经是按双薪收入这种新的状况的极限来制订的。

ex.en: Congress approved the education budget.
ex.zh: 国会批准了教育预算。

ex.en: The project was cancelled because of budget cuts.
ex.zh: 由于预算削减，该项目被取消了。

ex.en: Water buffalo have been used to plough the flooded fields of southern Asia for centuries.
ex.zh: 几个世纪以来，水牛一直被用来耕种南亚的水田。

senses: n. 缓冲物；起缓冲作用的人
n. 减震器，缓冲器；(计算机的)缓存区

ex.en: The fund acts as a buffer against unexpected falls in government revenue.
ex.zh: 这笔基金可作为缓冲，应对政府收入意外下滑。

senses: n. 自助餐，(车站等处的)快餐部，饮食柜台
v. (尤指风、雨或海浪)猛烈袭击

ex.en: The hotel offers a breakfast buffet featuring local produce from nearby farms.
ex.zh: 这家酒店提供自助早餐，主打来自附近农场的本地食材。

senses: n. 臭虫；小毛病；窃听器

ex.en: Programmers worked overnight to fix a bug that had exposed users' personal data.
ex.zh: 程序员们通宵工作，修复了一个泄露用户个人数据的程序故障。

ex.en: The charity helped villagers build a health centre with equipment donated by overseas supporters.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构帮助村民建造了一所医疗中心，设备由海外捐助者捐赠。

ex.en: The old warehouse is the only building on the street to survive the fire intact.
ex.zh: 这座旧仓库是街上唯一在大火中完好无损的建筑。

ex.en: Replacing old bulbs with energy-saving models can cut a household's lighting costs by up to eighty percent.
ex.zh: 用节能灯泡替换旧灯泡最多可削减一个家庭百分之八十的照明开支。

ex.en: The bulk of the research budget goes to a few well-funded universities.
ex.zh: 大部分科研预算流向少数资金充足的大学。

ex.en: Supermarkets buy goods in bulk to reduce costs and offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 超市大批量采购商品以降低成本、提供更低的价格。

ex.en: The sheer bulk of the paperwork discouraged many applicants from applying.
ex.zh: 文书工作的繁重令许多申请者望而却步。

ex.en: The farmer keeps a bull to improve the herd, though it requires careful handling.
ex.zh: 农夫养了一头公牛来改良牛群，尽管它需要小心对待。

ex.en: The surgeon removed a bullet lodged near the soldier's shoulder during the four-hour operation.
ex.zh: 在四个小时的手术中，外科医生取出了卡在士兵肩部附近的子弹。

senses: n. 公告，布告；新闻简报

ex.en: The government will issue an official bulletin later this week.
ex.zh: 本周晚些时候政府将发布一则官方公告。

ex.en: The school publishes a monthly bulletin for parents and students.
ex.zh: 学校每月出版一份面向家长和学生的简报。

ex.en: A special news bulletin interrupted the evening programme with the election results.
ex.zh: 一期特别新闻简报插播选举结果，中断了晚间节目。

ex.en: In the highlands, farmers still use a pair of bullocks to plough the terraced fields.
ex.zh: 在高原地区，农民仍然用一对阉牛耕种梯田。

ex.en: Schools are training teachers to spot the early signs of children who bully their classmates.
ex.zh: 学校正在培训教师识别欺负同学的孩子的早期迹象。

senses: n. 碰撞,隆起物,肿胀,肿块

ex.en: The van bumped into the gatepost while reversing down the narrow lane.
ex.zh: 货车在倒车驶下狭窄的小巷时撞上了门柱。

ex.en: He arrived carrying a bunch of flowers for his former teacher on her retirement day.
ex.zh: 在他的老师退休那天，他捧着一束花前来探望。

ex.en: She tied the old newspapers into a bundle and left them for the recycling collectors.
ex.zh: 她把旧报纸捆成一捆，留给回收人员收走。

burden.usage: 发音类似"笨蛋"→笨蛋跟着你，真是个"负担"啊；索引p404

ex.en: The main burden of caring for old people falls on the state.
ex.zh: 国家担负起了照料老人的大部分责任。

ex.en: Rising rents place a heavy burden on young workers in big cities.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的房租给大城市的年轻劳动者造成沉重负担。

ex.en: The new tax burden will fall mainly on middle-income families.
ex.zh: 新的税收负担将主要落在中等收入家庭身上。

ex.en: He refused to burden his parents with his business debts.
ex.zh: 他拒绝让父母背负他的生意债务。

senses: adj. 负担沉重的,繁重的

ex.en: Small firms complain that the new reporting rules are far too burdensome for businesses of their size.
ex.zh: 小公司抱怨新的申报规定对它们这种规模的企业来说负担太重。

senses: n. （提供某方面信息的）办事处；（美国政府部门）局
bureau.usage: 发音类似“不弱”→在科室和局里办事的人，一般还真不弱→局，科，处。；索引p404

ex.en: The weather bureau makes daily reports on weather conditions.
ex.zh: 气象局每天报告天气状况。

ex.en: The census bureau will publish the latest population figures next month.
ex.zh: 人口普查局将于下月公布最新人口数据。

ex.en: She runs the Washington bureau of a national newspaper.
ex.zh: 她管理着一家全国性报纸的华盛顿分社。

ex.en: The tourist bureau helped us arrange every detail of the trip.
ex.zh: 旅游办事处帮我们安排了旅行的每个细节。

senses: n. 官僚,官僚作风,官僚机构
n. 官僚体制；官僚作风
bureaucracy.usage: 派生 bureaucratic adj. 官僚的；bureaucrat n. 官员；n.官僚制度，官僚主义；官僚；索引p404

ex.en: Small firms complain that endless bureaucracy delays every permit.
ex.zh: 小企业抱怨没完没了的官僚程序拖延每一份许可证。

ex.en: The reform aims to cut bureaucracy and speed up decision-making.
ex.zh: 这项改革旨在精简官僚机构、加快决策。

ex.en: Years of thick bureaucracy discouraged foreign investors from entering the market.
ex.zh: 多年繁重的官僚作风使外国投资者不敢进入该市场。

ex.en: Critics argue that unelected bureaucrats wield too much influence over national policy decisions.
ex.zh: 批评人士认为，未经选举产生的官僚对国家政策决策的影响过大。

senses: adj. 官僚的；官僚主义的

ex.en: Small firms complain that bureaucratic procedures delay licence approvals by several months.
ex.zh: 小企业抱怨官僚程序使执照审批拖延了好几个月。

burglar.usage: 派生 burglary n. 入户行窃,入户盗窃罪

ex.en: The burglar entered through an unlocked window and took only cash and jewellery.
ex.zh: 窃贼从一扇未上锁的窗户进入，只拿走了现金和首饰。

ex.en: Wildfires burn thousands of hectares of forest each summer, releasing vast quantities of carbon dioxide.
ex.zh: 每年夏天野火烧毁数千公顷森林，释放出大量二氧化碳。

ex.en: The council asks residents to separate burnable waste from recyclable material before collection.
ex.zh: 市政部门要求居民在垃圾收集前把可燃垃圾与可回收物分开。

senses: n. [C,U] 过度劳累；精疲力竭；（火箭）熄火点，燃烧终止

ex.en: Hospitals are introducing shorter shifts to reduce burnout among nurses working long hours.
ex.zh: 医院正在推行更短的轮班制度，以减少长时间工作护士的职业倦怠。

senses: v. 突然发生,突然发作

ex.en: The old pipe burst during the night, flooding the basement of the entire building.
ex.zh: 夜里旧水管爆裂，淹没了整栋楼的地下室。

ex.en: The ancient city was buried under volcanic ash for centuries before its rediscovery.
ex.zh: 这座古城在火山灰下掩埋了数个世纪才被重新发现。

ex.en: The city added night buses on main routes to help shift workers get home safely.
ex.zh: 该市在主要线路上增开夜间公交，帮助倒班工人安全回家。

ex.en: Goats graze on the bushes covering the hillside, naturally clearing land that once hosted farmland.
ex.zh: 山羊啃食覆盖山坡的灌木，自然清理了曾是农田的土地。

business.usage: 真题另考：Trust is a tricky business.（2018）保持信任是一件难办的事；n. 职责义见 2009 年翻译；索引p404

ex.en: The difference between C-grade and A-grade managers may very well be the difference between business success or failure.
ex.zh: C级和A级管理者之间的差别很可能就是企业的成败之别。

ex.en: Small businesses create most of the new jobs in the country.
ex.zh: 小企业创造了该国大部分新增就业岗位。

ex.en: She went to Paris on business rather than for pleasure.
ex.zh: 她去巴黎是出差而不是游玩。

ex.en: The wealthy businessman donated his entire art collection to the national gallery.
ex.zh: 这位富有的商人把他的全部艺术收藏捐赠给了国家美术馆。

senses: n. 半身像;女子胸部,胸围;逮捕;搜捕;突击搜查;没价值的事物
v. 弄坏,打碎;逮捕;搜查

ex.en: A bronze bust of the novelist stands in the library where she once worked as a clerk.
ex.zh: 这位小说家的青铜半身像矗立在她曾做过职员的图书馆里。

senses: a. 忙碌的；繁忙的；热闹的；（电话）占线的

ex.en: Farmers are busiest in September, when the harvest must be gathered before the autumn rains.
ex.zh: 农民在九月最忙，因为必须在秋雨来临之前完成收割。

ex.en: The plan seemed perfect on paper, but it collapsed as soon as costs were calculated.
ex.zh: 这项计划在纸面上看似完美，但成本一算出来就化为泡影。

ex.en: The butcher explained which cut of beef would suit slow cooking best.
ex.zh: 肉商解释了哪一块牛肉最适合慢炖。

ex.en: Nutrition advisers now recommend replacing butter with olive oil in most everyday cooking.
ex.zh: 营养顾问现在建议在大多数日常烹饪中用橄榄油代替黄油。

ex.en: Monarch butterflies travel thousands of miles each autumn to reach their winter breeding grounds.
ex.zh: 帝王蝶每年秋天飞行数千英里，到达它们过冬的繁殖地。

ex.en: Press the green button and wait for the signal before crossing the busy road.
ex.zh: 按下绿色按钮，等信号出现后再穿过繁忙的马路。

senses: vt. 够支付；收买；付出极大代价而获得

ex.en: Consumers increasingly buy second-hand clothes to save money and reduce textile waste.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越多地购买二手服装，以省钱并减少纺织品浪费。

senses: n. [U] （对政策或变更的）认可，接受

ex.en: The reform will fail without the buy-in of the teachers who have to carry it out.
ex.zh: 如果得不到必须执行改革的教师们的认同，这项改革就会失败。

senses: n. 嗡嗡声,蜂鸣声,嘈杂的谈话声
v. 发生嗡嗡声,发出蜂鸣声

ex.en: There was an excited buzz in the office on the morning the merger was announced.
ex.zh: 合并消息公布的那个上午，办公室里一片兴奋的嘈杂议论声。

senses: n. (媒体上的)时髦术语,流行行话

ex.en: Sustainability has become a buzzword in the fashion industry, though practice often lags behind the language.
ex.zh: “可持续”已成为时装业的一个流行词，尽管实践往往落后于言辞。

senses: prep. 在……旁边；由于；不迟于；在……之前

ex.en: By combining satellite data with field surveys, researchers mapped the shrinking wetlands in remarkable detail.
ex.zh: 通过将卫星数据与实地调查相结合，研究人员极为详细地绘制出不断萎缩的湿地地图。

ex.en: By comparison with last year's figures, sales of electric vehicles have almost doubled.
ex.zh: 与去年的数字相比，电动汽车的销量几乎翻了一番。

senses: n. 副产品;附带产生的后果
by-product.usage: 组合词：by(在旁边)+product(产品)→在（主营产品）旁边的产品→副产品；索引p404

ex.en: Electricity is a useful by-product of the waste-burning process.
ex.zh: 电力是垃圾焚烧过程的有用副产品。

ex.en: Increased tourism is often a by-product of hosting major sporting events.
ex.zh: 旅游业增长往往是举办重大体育赛事的附带产物。

ex.en: Methane is a by-product of agriculture and a powerful greenhouse gas.
ex.zh: 甲烷是农业的副产品，也是一种强效温室气体。

senses: n. (心脏、动脉的)分流术,搭桥术,旁通管
bypass.usage: [记] by（在……旁边）+pass（通过）→在我旁边通过→绕过。[近] round vt. 绕过；索引p404

ex.en: A new bypass will carry heavy traffic away from the town centre.
ex.zh: 一条新的旁路将把繁忙的车流引离市中心。

ex.en: Patients with blocked arteries may need an operation to bypass the damaged vessels.
ex.zh: 动脉堵塞的患者可能需要手术来绕过受损的血管。

ex.en: The manager warned employees not to bypass the standard safety procedures.
ex.zh: 经理告诫员工不得绕开标准安全流程。

ex.en: Cheese whey, once discarded as a byproduct, is now sold to the fitness industry as a protein source.
ex.zh: 乳清曾被当作副产品丢弃，如今作为蛋白质来源出售给健身行业。

ex.en: Water freezes at 0 °C and boils at 100 °C at standard atmospheric pressure.
ex.zh: 在标准大气压下，水在0摄氏度结冰，在100摄氏度沸腾。

senses: n. 出租马车,出租汽车,计程车

ex.en: She hailed a cab outside the station because the last train had already left.
ex.zh: 由于末班火车已经开走，她在车站外招了一辆出租车。

ex.en: Farmers in the region grow cabbage through the winter because it tolerates frost well.
ex.zh: 该地区的农民整个冬天都种植卷心菜，因为它很耐霜冻。

ex.en: The writer withdrew to a remote cabin each summer to finish his novels in silence.
ex.zh: 这位作家每年夏天都躲进偏远的小木屋，在寂静中完成他的小说。

ex.en: The minister resigned after the cabinet rejected her proposal for education reform.
ex.zh: 内阁否决了她的教育改革提案后，这位大臣辞职了。

senses: n. 缆绳；电缆；有线电视

ex.en: Workers laid a submarine cable to connect the internet networks of two continents.
ex.zh: 工人们铺设了海底电缆，把两大洲的互联网连接起来。

ex.en: Many households have switched from cable to streaming services in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来许多家庭从有线电视转向了流媒体服务。

ex.en: The bridge is supported by thick steel cables strong enough to bear enormous loads.
ex.zh: 这座大桥由足以承受巨大负荷的粗钢缆支撑。

ex.en: The desert cactus stores water in its thick stem to survive months without rain.
ex.zh: 沙漠仙人掌把水分储存在粗壮的茎里，以便在数月无雨的情况下存活。

ex.en: The corner cafe fills with students every morning, drawn by cheap coffee and free wireless.
ex.zh: 每天早晨，这家街角咖啡馆都挤满学生，他们被便宜的咖啡和免费无线网络吸引而来。

ex.en: Cafe owners in the old town say tourism has changed both their menus and their customers.
ex.zh: 老城区的咖啡馆老板说，旅游业改变了他们的菜单，也改变了他们的顾客。

ex.en: The school cafeteria now sources most of its vegetables from farms within thirty miles.
ex.zh: 学校自助餐厅现在的大部分蔬菜都采购自三十英里以内的农场。

ex.en: Animal welfare groups campaign against keeping parrots in small cages for their entire lives.
ex.zh: 动物福利组织发起运动，反对把鹦鹉终生关在小笼子里。

ex.en: The bakery sells out of its chocolate cake within hours every weekend.
ex.zh: 这家面包店的巧克力蛋糕每个周末几小时内就会售罄。

ex.en: Milk and green vegetables provide the calcium that growing children need for strong bones.
ex.zh: 牛奶和绿色蔬菜提供成长中的儿童强健骨骼所需的钙。

ex.en: Astronomers can now calculate the exact dates of eclipses centuries in advance.
ex.zh: 天文学家如今能提前数百年精确计算出日食和月食的日期。

calculate.usage: 近义辨析:count逐个算;figure用数字推算;account解释说明；cal(开)+cu(联想QQ)+late(晚的)→算错时差没聊成QQ→计算；索引p404

ex.en: Use the formula to calculate the volume of the container.
ex.zh: 用公式计算容器的容积。

ex.en: Engineers calculate the maximum load each new bridge can safely carry.
ex.zh: 工程师计算每座新桥能安全承受的最大荷载。

ex.en: She had calculated that the journey would cost no more than eight hundred dollars.
ex.zh: 她算过这趟旅程的花费不会超过八百美元。

ex.en: The generous refund policy was clearly calculated to win back angry customers.
ex.zh: 慷慨的退款政策显然是经过算计以赢回愤怒顾客的。

ex.en: Cathy did a rough calculation.
ex.zh: 凯茜做了一个粗略的计算。

ex.en: Students may use a calculator in the statistics exam but not in the arithmetic paper.
ex.zh: 学生可以在统计学考试中使用计算器，但在算术试卷中不可以。

senses: n. 日历；历书；历法；日程表；重大事件
calendar.usage: 上班族每天拿着日历calendar数日子，算算calculate什么时候过年

ex.en: This is one of the biggest weeks in the racing calendar.
ex.zh: 这是全年赛马日程表中最重要的几个星期之一。

ex.en: The academic calendar has been adjusted because of the public health emergency.
ex.zh: 由于公共卫生突发事件，校历已作调整。

ex.en: Marking deadlines on a calendar helps students manage their study plans.
ex.zh: 在日历上标出截止日期有助于学生管理学习计划。

call.usage: call at短暂访问;call forth引起;call on/upon访问,呼吁;call up打电话,召集,使人想起；索引p404

ex.en: A group of labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK "town of culture" award.
ex.zh: 正值迎接新年之际，包括伊薇特·库珀在内的一群工党议员呼吁设立一项英国“文化小镇”奖。

ex.en: Experts issued a call for stricter regulation of artificial intelligence.
ex.zh: 专家们发出呼吁，要求对人工智能实施更严格的监管。

ex.en: She received a call from the university offering her a place on the programme.
ex.zh: 她接到大学打来的电话，通知录取她进入该项目。

calm.usage: 派生:calmly adv.平静镇定地;calmness n.安静,平静；难过时给妈妈(m)打电话(call)，心情好多了就"平静"了；索引p404

ex.en: They were impressed by her calm demeanour.
ex.zh: 她平静的举止给他们留下了深刻印象。

ex.en: Try to remain calm and describe exactly what happened.
ex.zh: 尽量保持镇静，准确描述发生了什么。

ex.en: The sea was perfectly calm early on Tuesday morning.
ex.zh: 周二清晨海面风平浪静。

ex.en: She calmed the frightened child by singing softly to him.
ex.zh: 她轻声为孩子唱歌，让他平静下来。

calorie.usage: 音译“卡路里”;派生calorific adj.生热的,发热的

ex.en: Soft drinks sweetened with sugar can contain more than two hundred calories a can.
ex.zh: 含糖软饮料每罐的热量可超过两百卡路里。

camel.usage: 助记:camel(骆驼)came(来了);dromedary单峰骆驼;two-humped双峰骆驼

ex.en: Camels can survive for weeks without water, making them ideal for desert trade routes.
ex.zh: 骆驼能在无水条件下存活数周，这使它们成为沙漠商路上理想的运输工具。

ex.en: Security cameras recorded the vehicle shortly before it left the car park.
ex.zh: 监控摄像头在这辆车驶离停车场前不久拍到了它。

phrases.m: 装腔作势地表演,矫揉造作

ex.en: The climbers established a base camp at 4,000 metres before attempting the final ascent.
ex.zh: 登山者在海拔四千米处建立了大本营，然后尝试最后的冲顶。

campaign.usage: 指为社会或政治变革而进行的一系列活动；辨析:campaign有组织的运动;motion抽象的动,多用于科技;movement具体的运动动作；n.活动，运动；战役，战 斗 v.领导运动；发音类似“背拼”→在这场“战役”中，每个战士都背拼命守卫自己的国家和人民→战役。；索引p404

ex.en: Its Campaign to Protect Rural England struck terror into many local Conservative parties.
ex.zh: 它保护英格兰农村的活动让许多地方保守党感到害怕。

ex.en: The government launched a nationwide campaign to persuade citizens to sort their household rubbish.
ex.zh: 政府发起了一场全国性运动，劝说公民对家庭垃圾进行分类。

ex.en: Environmental groups are campaigning for stricter limits on carbon emissions from heavy industry.
ex.zh: 环保组织正在发起运动，要求对重工业的碳排放实施更严格的限制。

ex.en: The veteran campaigner has spent three decades fighting for stricter air-pollution laws.
ex.zh: 这位资深的运动人士三十年来一直在为更严格的空气污染法而奔走。

campus.usage: camp(营地)+us(我们)→我们学生的营地→校园

ex.en: Many students seems to love the campus diversity.
ex.zh: 很多学生似乎喜欢校园的多样性。

ex.en: Otherwise outside directors will follow the example of Ms. Simmons, once again very popular on campus.
ex.zh: 否则，外部董事将会效仿西蒙斯女士的做法，重返学校仍能大受欢迎。

ex.en: The university is investing heavily in new libraries and campus housing.
ex.zh: 这所大学正投入巨资建设新图书馆和校内住房。

can.usage: as...as can be再……不过了,极其

ex.en: Soup sold in a can often contains far more salt than the homemade variety.
ex.zh: 罐头装的汤通常比自制汤含有多得多的盐。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Canada is the second-largest country in the world by area, yet most of its population lives near the American border.
ex.zh: 加拿大按国土面积是世界第二大国，但其大部分人口居住在靠近美国边境的地带。

ex.en: The canal linking the two seas shortened shipping routes by thousands of miles.
ex.zh: 连接两海的运河将航运路线缩短了数千英里。

ex.en: Barges once carried coal along the canal to the industrial cities.
ex.zh: 驳船曾沿着运河把煤运往工业城市。

ex.en: Urban planners proposed restoring the old canal to attract visitors to the city.
ex.zh: 城市规划者提议修复老运河以吸引游客进城。

cancel.usage: 派生cancellation n.取消,被取消的事物；发音类似“看馊了”→馊了赶紧退了取消交易→取消。；cancel 过去式 cancelled/canceled 均可；cancellation n. 取消。

ex.en: All flights have been cancelled because of bad weather.
ex.zh: 因天气恶劣，所有航班均已取消。

ex.en: The flight was cancelled due to bad weather.
ex.zh: 航班因恶劣天气被取消。

ex.en: The airline cancelled dozens of flights when the ash cloud drifted across Europe.
ex.zh: 火山灰云飘过欧洲上空时，航空公司取消了数十个航班。

ex.en: He cancelled his newspaper subscription after the editorial line changed.
ex.zh: 报纸编辑立场改变后，他取消了订阅。

senses: n. 迅速蔓延的恶劣的或危险的事物(c)
cancer.usage: 派生cancerous adj.(似)癌的,患癌症的

ex.en: Early screening programmes have significantly improved survival rates for several common cancers.
ex.zh: 早期筛查计划显著提高了几种常见癌症的存活率。

senses: n. 候选人；申请人；投考者
candidate.usage: n.候选人，申请者；考生；can（能够）+did（做）+ate（吃）→能做的只有吃。你作为“候选人”心中紧张，能做的就是吃东西以缓解紧张的心情。；索引p404

ex.en: All tests require a potential candidate with whom to compare DNA.
ex.zh: 所有的测试都需要和一个潜在候选人员的DNA进行比对。

ex.en: AI looks at résumés in greater numbers than humans would be able to, and selects the more promising candidates.
ex.zh: 人工智能查看简历的数量远多于人类，并能筛选出更有潜力的候选人。

ex.en: Interviewers should assess whether a candidate fits the team rather than relying on test scores alone.
ex.zh: 面试官应当评估候选人是否适合团队，而不应仅依赖考试分数。

ex.en: Villagers lit candles when the storm cut electricity to the whole valley for two days.
ex.zh: 暴风雨切断了整个山谷的电力两天，村民们点起了蜡烛。

ex.en: Dentists urge parents to limit candy between meals rather than banning it entirely.
ex.zh: 牙医敦促家长限制孩子在两餐之间吃糖果，而不是完全禁止。

ex.en: A salvo from the ship's cannon signalled the start of the annual festival.
ex.zh: 军舰上的礼炮齐鸣，宣告一年一度的节庆开始。

ex.en: The guides paddled the canoe downstream, pointing out rare birds along the forested banks.
ex.zh: 向导们划着独木舟顺流而下，一路指出森林两岸的珍稀鸟类。

senses: n. 大教堂教士;原则,准则,法规
n. (尤指)基督教教规;精品集;真作集

ex.en: Her early novels are now part of the canon of post-war literature.
ex.zh: 她的早期小说如今已成为战后文学经典的一部分。

ex.en: Workers at the factory eat lunch in the canteen, which opens at half past eleven.
ex.zh: 工厂的工人在食堂吃午饭，食堂十一点半开门。

ex.en: The painter stretched a fresh canvas and began sketching the harbour at dawn.
ex.zh: 画家绷好一张新画布，开始勾勒黎明的海港。

ex.en: He wore a woollen cap to keep warm while working in the frozen warehouse.
ex.zh: 他在冰冷的仓库干活时戴着一顶毛线帽保暖。

capability.usage: n.能力，才能；军事力量 随着trade 结束，他的职业career 也结束了，从此离开了association。Therefore，他将成为一名amateur， 需要重新design 他further 的生活。作为曾经supreme 的球；索引p404

ex.en: The new submarine demonstrates the country's growing capability to operate in deep water.
ex.zh: 这艘新潜艇展示了该国日益增强的深水作业能力。

senses: adj. 有能力的,能胜任的
adj. 有能力的，能力很强的
adj. 有能力的；足以胜任的
capable.usage: 同义:competent；adj.有能力的；有本领的， 能干的；词根:cap(take拿)+able(能…的)→能拿…的→有能力的；例为2016年翻译；索引p404

ex.en: Our mental health doesn't really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant.
ex.zh: 我们的心理健康并没有真正离开，如同云彩后面的太阳，它可能暂时离开我们的视线，但完全可以瞬间恢复如初。

ex.en: The new chip is capable of processing millions of images per second without overheating.
ex.zh: 这款新芯片每秒能处理数百万张图像而不过热。

ex.en: She is a highly capable administrator who turned the failing school into a model within five years.
ex.zh: 她是一位非常能干的管理者，在五年内把这所陷入困境的学校变成了示范学校。

capacity.usage: 辨析:ability现有能力;faculty内在能力生理功能;capacity容纳接受能力;capability实际潜在能力；cap(抓住)+acity(有……倾向)→有抓住的倾向，拿住的能力→容量；能力；词根:cap(take拿)+acity(表状态)→能拿住→能力；n.容量例为2007年阅读；索引p404

ex.en: The theatre has a seating capacity of 2,000.
ex.zh: 那座剧院能容纳2000名观众。

ex.en: Winter-born babies tend to have higher oxygen capacity, which increases soccer stamina.
ex.zh: 冬季出生的孩子往往具有较高的血氧容量，这就增强了他们踢足球的耐力。

ex.en: The new stadium has a capacity of sixty thousand and meets all international safety standards.
ex.zh: 新体育场可容纳六万人，符合所有国际安全标准。

ex.en: The lighthouse stands on a rocky cape pounded by heavy seas for most of the year.
ex.zh: 灯塔矗立在一处多岩石的海角上，一年中大部分时间经受巨浪冲击。

senses: n. 首都,首府;大写字母
capital.usage: 派生:capitalism n.资本主义；n.资本，资金；首都；大写字母 adj.死刑的；大写的；索引p404

ex.en: It's increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom.
ex.zh: 对于资本主义和自由来说,目的的缺失以及政府、媒体和商界中道德语言的缺失,很可能会变成最危险的隐患之一,这一点愈发明显。

ex.en: Finally, because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income, taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought.
ex.zh: 最后，由于自动化可能导致资本收入与劳动者收入之间的差距加大，税收和安全保障体系将不得不重新考虑。

ex.en: Wellington, the capital of New Zealand, hosts the festival every two years.
ex.zh: 新西兰首都惠灵顿每两年举办一次该艺术节。

ex.en: Many small firms fail simply because they cannot raise enough capital.
ex.zh: 许多小企业失败仅仅是因为筹不到足够的资本。

capitalism.usage: n.资本主义；词根记忆：capital(资本)+ism(主义)→资本主义。；索引p404

ex.en: Critics argue that unchecked capitalism widens the gap between rich and poor.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，不受约束的资本主义会扩大贫富差距。

ex.en: Modern capitalism depends on consumer confidence as much as on production.
ex.zh: 现代资本主义既依赖生产，也同样依赖消费者信心。

ex.en: The book traces how capitalism shaped the development of global trade.
ex.zh: 该书追溯了资本主义如何塑造了全球贸易的发展。

ex.en: Hayden sensed that he could capitalize on the expedition's stunning visuals.
ex.zh: 海登意识到他可以利用这次探险中(拍摄的)那些令人惊叹的照片。

ex.en: The astronaut reported that the capsule landed safely in the sea after its six-month mission.
ex.zh: 宇航员报告说，太空舱在结束六个月的任务后安全降落在海面上。

ex.en: The new sensors capture temperature data every hour and transmit it to the laboratory.
ex.zh: 新传感器每小时采集一次温度数据，并将其传送到实验室。

senses: n. [C] （陆军或美国空军的）上尉

phrases.p: a captain in the British army

captain.usage: 记：capt（头）+-ain（名词后缀）→队里领头的人→队长

ex.en: The captain ordered everyone on deck as the storm approached the ferry.
ex.zh: 风暴逼近渡轮时，船长命令所有人到甲板上。

ex.en: Every photograph in the exhibition carries a caption naming the place and the year.
ex.zh: 展览中的每张照片都配有说明文字，标明拍摄地点和年份。

senses: adj. 被关押的；被俘虏的
captive.usage: adj.被圈养的 n.俘虏；索引p404

ex.en: The pirates held the crew captive for several months before demanding a ransom from the shipping company.
ex.zh: 海盗将船员劫持数月，随后向航运公司索要赎金。

ex.en: Passengers on long-haul flights form a captive audience for whatever films the airline chooses to show.
ex.zh: 长途航班上的乘客构成了被动受众，只能观看航空公司选定的影片。

ex.en: The captive soldiers were questioned about the position of their troops.
ex.zh: 被俘士兵被询问其部队的部署位置。

ex.en: After six weeks in captivity, the journalist finally persuaded his captor to release him.
ex.zh: 被囚六周后，这名记者终于说动了扣押他的人放他走。

capture.usage: 同根(capt抓):captivity被俘监禁;captivation吸引力;captivate迷惑吸引;recapture夺回；cap(=cep"抓，拿")+t+ure(动词后缀)→捕获；词根记忆：capt(take,抓住)+ure(名词后缀)→俘获；赢得。；索引p404

ex.en: His story captured the attention of Hollywood.
ex.zh: 他的故事引起了好莱坞的注意。

ex.en: The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother's attention.
ex.zh: 这个孩子在努力引起母亲注意的过程中，变得越来越难过。

ex.en: Such actions to seek knowledge and to understand what information we already knew were captured by the Latin phrase "sapere aude" or "dare to know".
ex.zh: 拉丁语短语sapere aude(敢于求知)描述的是探求真知并理解已知信息这种行为。

ex.en: Capuchin monkeys, found across Central and South America, are known for their remarkable skill with simple tools.
ex.zh: 分布于中南美洲的卷尾猴以使用简单工具的高超本领著称。

ex.en: Electric car sales doubled last year, encouraged by tax breaks and new charging stations.
ex.zh: 在税收优惠和新充电站的推动下，电动汽车销量去年翻了一番。

senses: n. [C] 旅行拖车（无发动机，由其他车拖动，多供度假时住宿用）；（供居住用的）有篷马车，大篷车；（尤指穿越沙漠的）旅行队，车队
n. 大篷车;宿营拖车;旅行队,车队

ex.en: Traders crossed the desert in a caravan of camels loaded with silk and spices.
ex.zh: 商人们组成骆驼商队穿越沙漠，驮着丝绸和香料。

senses: n. [C] （旧时亚洲和北非沙漠地区的）商队客店

ex.en: Along the old Silk Road, merchants rested their animals at a caravanserai before crossing the next desert.
ex.zh: 在古老的丝绸之路上，商旅们在穿越下一片沙漠之前，先在商队旅馆歇脚喂牲口。

senses: n. [化]碳水化合物,醣类；碳水化合物食物(c)

ex.en: Nutrition labels now list not only calories but also the grams of carbohydrate in each serving.
ex.zh: 现在的营养成分标签不仅列出热量，还标明每份食物中碳水化合物的克数。

carbon.usage: 元素符号 C。搭配：low-carbon a. 低碳的

ex.en: The treaty commits signatories to cutting carbon emissions by half before 2040.
ex.zh: 该条约签署国承诺在2040年前将碳排放量减半。

senses: n. 动物尸体;(尤指供食用的)畜体;残骸,骨架

ex.en: Vultures gathered around the carcass of an antelope within minutes of its death.
ex.zh: 羚羊死后不过几分钟，秃鹫便聚集在它的尸体周围。

senses: n. 卡片,名片,纸牌,纸片

ex.en: The library issues membership cards that readers can also use to reserve books online.
ex.zh: 图书馆发放会员卡，读者也可以用它在线预订图书。

senses: adj. 心脏的；（与）心脏病（有关）的

ex.en: Regular moderate exercise is known to reduce the risk of cardiac disease in middle age.
ex.zh: 众所周知，规律的中等强度运动能降低中年时期患心脏病的风险。

ex.en: Respect for evidence is a cardinal principle of all scientific research.
ex.zh: 尊重证据是一切科学研究的基本原则。

ex.en: Studies consistently show that elderly people receive better care at home than in many institutions.
ex.zh: 研究一致表明，老年人在家得到的照料好于在许多机构里的照料。

career.usage: n.职业，事业；职业生涯；索引p404

ex.en: They will need to be constantly up-skilling throughout their career to stay employable.
ex.zh: 他们将需要在整个职业生涯中不断提高技能，以保持就业能力。

ex.en: She abandoned a promising legal career to devote herself to environmental research.
ex.zh: 她放弃了颇有前途的法律职业，投身于环境研究。

ex.en: Workers who lack digital skills may find their career prospects severely limited in the coming decades.
ex.zh: 缺乏数字技能的劳动者可能会发现，未来几十年自己的职业前景将受到严重限制。

ex.en: Taking a career break is no longer viewed as damaging to long-term professional development.
ex.zh: 休职业空白期如今不再被视为对长期职业发展有害。

phrases.m: 追求无忧无虑的阅读体验

carefree.usage: adj.无忧无虑的，无牵挂的；索引p404

ex.en: Photographs show a carefree childhood spent swimming in the river behind their house.
ex.zh: 照片记录了一段无忧无虑的童年，那时他们在屋后的河里游泳。

careful.usage: 反义:careless;派生:carefully adv.仔细地；adj.仔细的，小心的；谨慎的， 周密的

ex.en: Careful analysis of the data revealed a flaw in the original hypothesis.
ex.zh: 对数据的仔细分析揭示了最初假设中的一个缺陷。

ex.en: Be careful not to confuse correlation with causation when reading such studies.
ex.zh: 阅读这类研究时，注意不要把相关性与因果关系混为一谈。

ex.en: After careful consideration, the committee approved the funding proposal.
ex.zh: 经过慎重考虑，委员会批准了这项拨款提案。

ex.en: The watchmaker works with quiet carefulness, fitting each tiny wheel into place by hand.
ex.zh: 钟表匠静心细致地工作，用手把每个微小的齿轮安装到位。

caregiver.usage: 组合词：care(照顾)+give(给)+(e)r(表人)→提供照顾的人→看护者；索引p404

ex.en: Support groups help caregivers cope with the physical and emotional demands of looking after relatives.
ex.zh: 支持团体帮助护理者应对照顾亲属在体力和情感上的压力。

careless.usage: adj.粗心的；不在意的；随意的

ex.en: A careless typing error in the contract nearly cost the company its biggest client.
ex.zh: 合同中一个粗心大意的录入错误差点让公司失去最大的客户。

cargo.usage: car(汽车)+go(走)→汽车可以拉走货物→货物

ex.en: The port handles cargo worth billions of pounds every year, from grain to electronics.
ex.zh: 该港口每年处理的货物价值数十亿英镑，从谷物到电子产品。

ex.en: The carnival draws hundreds of thousands of visitors to the city every February.
ex.zh: 每年二月，狂欢节都吸引数十万游客来到这座城市。

ex.en: A master carpenter was in charge of teaching the apprentices.
ex.zh: 一个木匠师傅负责教学徒。

ex.en: The carpenter measured the wood twice before cutting it to size.
ex.zh: 木匠下料前把木料量了两遍。

ex.en: Skilled carpenters are in short supply as few young people learn the trade.
ex.zh: 由于很少有年轻人学这一行，熟练木匠供不应求。

senses: v. 用地毯铺(房间的)地

ex.en: Volunteers rolled out a red carpet to welcome the delegation at the village entrance.
ex.zh: 志愿者们在村口铺开红地毯欢迎代表团。

ex.en: In Victorian times, a horse-drawn carriage remained a luxury few working families could afford.
ex.zh: 在维多利亚时代，马拉四轮马车仍是很少有工薪家庭能负担得起的奢侈品。

carrier.usage: 记：carr（车）+-ier（名词后缀）→用车运送货物的专业组织→运输公司

ex.en: The airline has grown into the country's largest air cargo carrier within a decade.
ex.zh: 这家航空公司在十年内发展成为该国最大的航空货运公司。

senses: n. (为说服人做事所许诺的)报酬,好处

phrases.p: hold out (or offer) a carrot to sb.

ex.en: The scheme uses a lower tax rate as a carrot to encourage firms to invest.
ex.zh: 该计划以较低的税率作为诱饵，鼓励企业投资。

carry.usage: 词组carry out贯彻,执行,实现；①带来(2006)②销售(2016)③刊登(2010)④承担；carry through（常指艰难地）坚持做，完成；carry the burden 承受重担；索引p404

ex.en: The things that bring the greatest joy carry the greatest potential for loss and disappointment.
ex.zh: 能（给人们）带来最大欢乐的事物，也最有可能带来失落和失望。

ex.en: Mosquitoes can carry dangerous diseases such as malaria and dengue fever.
ex.zh: 蚊子能传播疟疾和登革热等危险疾病。

ex.en: The new railway will carry over a million passengers a year.
ex.zh: 新铁路每年将运送超过一百万名乘客。

ex.en: Shoppers load their cart with goods and pay at the self-service machines near the exit.
ex.zh: 顾客把商品装进购物手推车，在出口附近的自助机上付款。

ex.en: Editorial cartoons often convey political criticism more sharply than a thousand written words.
ex.zh: 政论漫画传达政治批评往往比千言万语更犀利。

carve.usage: 派生carver n.雕刻者；切肉的人;carving n.雕刻品；雕刻术；v.雕，刻；切下；赢得

ex.en: Ancient craftsmen carved intricate patterns into the stone pillars.
ex.zh: 古代工匠在石柱上雕刻出精美的图案。

ex.en: The region was carved into several small states after the empire collapsed.
ex.zh: 帝国崩溃后，该地区被分割成几个小国。

ex.en: She carved the turkey and served it to the waiting guests.
ex.zh: 她把火鸡切好，端给等候的客人。

ex.en: In this case, the court ruled that the contract was not legally binding.
ex.zh: 在这个案件中，法庭裁定该合同不具法律约束力。

senses: n. 小瀑布;瀑布状物;倾泻,倾注
v. 倾泻;流注;垂落;悬挂

ex.en: The failed dam sent a cascade of water through the valley, forcing thousands to evacuate.
ex.zh: 失事的大坝使水如瀑布般倾泻穿过山谷，迫使数千人撤离。

senses: n. [C] 特定情况；案例；案件；事实；诉讼

ex.en: But privacy is not the only angle in this case and not even the most important.
ex.zh: 但是在此次事件中，个人隐私并不是唯一的角度，甚至不是最为重要的。

ex.en: The lawyer cited a similar case decided by the court ten years earlier.
ex.zh: 律师援引了十年前法院裁定的一起类似案件。

ex.en: In case of fire, employees should leave the building by the nearest exit.
ex.zh: 如遇火灾，员工应从最近的出口撤离大楼。

ex.en: Many small shops refuse cash payments now that card and phone transactions dominate.
ex.zh: 由于刷卡和手机支付占主导地位，许多小店现在拒收现金。

cashier.usage: cash(付、收现款)+ier(名词后缀表示人)→收银员

ex.en: The cashier noticed that the note was counterfeit and alerted the store manager.
ex.zh: 收银员发现那张钞票是假币，便通知了店长。

ex.en: Sweden is close to becoming a cashless society, where even street vendors take card payments.
ex.zh: 瑞典已接近成为无现金社会，连街头小贩都接受刷卡支付。

casino.usage: n.赌场；联想记忆:在赌场(casino)把卡西欧(Casio)手表都输没了；索引p404

ex.en: The city relies heavily on tax revenue from its casinos.
ex.zh: 这座城市严重依赖赌场的税收收入。

ex.en: Researchers found that problem gambling rises in areas near a casino.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现，赌场附近地区的问题赌博现象有所增多。

ex.en: The casino refused to pay out his winnings, citing a technical rule.
ex.zh: 赌场以一条技术性规则为由拒绝支付他赢的钱。

ex.en: Before streaming, music fans copied songs from the radio onto cassette tapes.
ex.zh: 在流媒体出现之前，乐迷们把电台里的歌曲翻录到盒式磁带上。

ex.en: The film features a cast of largely unknown young actors.
ex.zh: 这部电影的主演阵容大多是无名的年轻演员。

ex.en: The scandal cast doubt on the company's promise of transparency.
ex.zh: 这一丑闻使人们对公司透明度的承诺产生了怀疑。

ex.en: The statue was cast in bronze over two hundred years ago.
ex.zh: 这尊雕像是两百多年前用青铜铸造的。

ex.en: The medieval castle was restored with public funds and now attracts over a million visitors a year.
ex.zh: 这座中世纪城堡用公共资金修复，如今每年吸引超过一百万游客。

senses: a. 随便的；漫不经心的
adj. 偶然的，无计划的，随便的，非正式的: a ~ meeting 邂逅 / a ~ worker 临时工 / ~ clothes 便装

ex.en: He tried to sound casual, but I knew he was worried.
ex.zh: 他讲话时试图显得不在乎，但我知道他心里着急。

ex.en: Even a casual observer could see that the two policies are contradictory.
ex.zh: 即使是漫不经心的观察者也能看出这两项政策相互矛盾。

ex.en: Casual dress is now accepted in most technology companies.
ex.zh: 如今大多数科技公司都接受穿便装上班。

ex.en: The farm relies heavily on casual workers during the busy harvest season.
ex.zh: 丰收旺季期间，这家农场严重依赖临时工。

ex.en: He mentioned casually that he had already accepted a job in Singapore.
ex.zh: 他不经意地提到自己已经接受了新加坡的一份工作。

ex.en: Her casualness about deadlines irritated colleagues who had stayed late to finish the project.
ex.zh: 她对待截止日期满不在乎的态度激怒了为完成项目而加班到深夜的同事。

senses: n. [动词casual(偶然的)+ty(名词后缀)] ①伤亡(者)，伤亡人数
【真】战事故事中的(伤亡者，牺牲者): The enemy suffered heavy casualties. 敌人伤亡惨重。
casualty.usage: n.伤亡人员；受害者 chancellor 认为，healthcare 是为了vast 人民的well-being，不是为了cater 某些人。所以在healthcare 中，不应该有gendergap 或racegap，这一点很好gras；索引p404

ex.en: The building collapsed without warning, but fortunately there were no casualties.
ex.zh: 大楼在毫无预警的情况下倒塌，所幸没有人员伤亡。

ex.en: Small bookshops have become the latest casualties of the shift to online shopping.
ex.zh: 小书店已成为向线上购物转变的最新受害者。

ex.en: Doctors worked through the night to treat casualties from the motorway accident.
ex.zh: 医生们连夜救治高速公路事故中的伤员。

ex.en: A cat kept in the granary protected stores of grain from mice and rats.
ex.zh: 养在谷仓里的猫保护储存的粮食免受老鼠侵害。

catalog.usage: cata(下面)+log(树干)→树干下放着目录→目录;辨析:list范围最广;roll官方成员名单;catalog按规则排列附说明;亦拼作catalogue

ex.en: The museum publishes an illustrated catalog of its collections every five years.
ex.zh: 该博物馆每五年出版一册插图版藏品目录。

catalogue.usage: cata（发音类似“开头”）+logue（说话）→重点放在开头形成“目录”。；索引p404

ex.en: New books are catalogued on an electronic database.
ex.zh: 新书被编入电子数据库。

ex.en: The museum is cataloguing its collection of nineteenth-century paintings.
ex.zh: 博物馆正在将十九世纪的绘画藏品编入目录。

ex.en: Shoppers once ordered clothes directly from the mail catalogue.
ex.zh: 购物者曾直接通过邮寄目录订购衣服。

senses: n. 突如其来的大灾难或大灾祸

ex.en: Failing to act on climate warnings could lead to an environmental catastrophe within decades.
ex.zh: 不对气候警告采取行动，可能在几十年内导致一场环境灾难。

senses: vt. 接；逮住；赶上；使突然遭受；得病

phrases.m: 用额外时间做某事，赶着做

ex.en: Hospitals urge visitors with colds to stay away so that patients do not catch the infection.
ex.zh: 医院敦促感冒的访客不要前来，以免病人被传染。

senses: n. ①(人或事物的)类别，种类，类目 类目(c)：place in a ~ 令门别类；列入目录中

ex.en: The European Union Framework funding programs have long had a category specifically targeted at social scientists. 长期以来，欧盟框架资助项目一直有一个针对社会科学家的专项类目。
ex.zh: 长期以来，欧盟框架资助项目一直有一个针对社会科学家的专项类目。

ex.en: The survey divided respondents into three categories according to household income.
ex.zh: 该调查将受访者按家庭收入分为三类。

ex.en: This product falls into a completely new category that existing regulations do not cover.
ex.zh: 该产品属于现有法规未涵盖的全新类别。

ex.en: Researchers placed the participants' answers into distinct categories before analysing them.
ex.zh: 研究人员在分析之前将参与者的回答归入不同的类别。

senses: vi. 提供饮食；承办酒席
vi. ①(for) 提供饮食，承办酒席: Fifty is a lot of people to ~ for! 承办五十人的饮食可够多的！
cater.usage: [搭配] cater to/for 迎合；v.提供餐饮，承办酒席；满足， 迎合；索引p404

ex.en: The hotel caters primarily for business travellers rather than tourists.
ex.zh: 这家酒店主要面向商务旅客而非游客。

ex.en: Online platforms must cater to users with widely different levels of digital literacy.
ex.zh: 在线平台必须满足数字素养水平差异很大的用户的需求。

ex.en: Several local firms were hired to cater for the international conference.
ex.zh: 数家本地公司受聘为这场国际会议提供餐饮服务。

ex.en: Tourists gather outside the cathedral every evening to hear the famous choir rehearse.
ex.zh: 游客们每晚聚集在大教堂外，聆听著名的唱诗班排练。

ex.en: The Catholic church played a central role in medieval European education.
ex.zh: 天主教会在中世纪欧洲的教育中发挥了核心作用。

ex.en: Roughly a quarter of the country's population identifies as Catholic.
ex.zh: 该国约四分之一的人口信仰天主教。

ex.en: The two Catholic schools merged last year because of falling enrolment.
ex.zh: 由于入学人数下降，两所天主教学校去年合并。

ex.en: Catholicism remained the dominant religion in the region long after the empire collapsed.
ex.zh: 帝国崩溃后很久，天主教仍是该地区占主导地位的宗教。

ex.en: The farmer kept fifty head of cattle on the hillside, selling milk and cheese in the nearby town each morning.
ex.zh: 农夫在山坡上养了五十头牛，每天早晨在附近的镇上出售牛奶和奶酪。

senses: adj. 原因的，表示因果的

ex.en: The study found a strong link between smoking and cancer but could not by itself establish a causal relationship.
ex.zh: 这项研究发现了吸烟与癌症之间的强关联，但仅凭其自身无法确立因果关系。

ex.en: Philosophers have long debated whether causality is a feature of the world or of the human mind.
ex.zh: 因果性究竟是世界的属性还是人类心智的属性，哲学家对此争论已久。

cause.usage: cause 指造成一种事实或现象的最直接的"原因、根源"，或导致某种结果的现象或条件；reason 指"推理"，指对于某个情况或看法从逻辑推理上引出结论的原因。

ex.en: Scientists are still debating the root cause of the disease, though several plausible explanations have been put forward.
ex.zh: 尽管已有几种看似合理的解释，科学家们仍在争论这种疾病的根本原因。

ex.en: Drivers are warned to be cautious on country roads where wild animals often cross at night.
ex.zh: 司机被提醒在乡间道路上要小心，那里常有野生动物夜间穿行。

senses: n. ①小心，谨慎(u): The general manager spoke with ~. 总经理讲话很谨慎。
caution.usage: 发音类似“靠身”→有人靠近身体时要“谨慎”“小心”。；索引p404

ex.en: Statistics should be treated with caution.
ex.zh: 对待统计数字要小心。

ex.en: But for all the reasons there are to celebrate the computer, we must also act with caution.
ex.zh: 然而，即使我们有无数理由可以颂扬电脑，我们也要小心谨慎。

ex.en: Doctors advise treating online health advice with caution, since much of it lacks scientific support.
ex.zh: 医生建议谨慎对待网上的健康建议，因为其中许多缺乏科学依据。

senses: adj. (of) 小心的，谨慎的: His father is always ~ of making decisions. 他父亲做出决定时总是很谨慎的。
cautious.usage: cautious 语意较弱，指十分小心，防止出危险或差错，常带提防的意味，例如：He was cautious of his personal safety. 他非常小心他的个人安全。careful 语意较强，指处处小心留意做事情，例如：He is always careful in doing his work. 他

ex.en: Employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
ex.zh: 雇主对雇佣新员工更加谨慎。

ex.en: Investors remain cautious about the technology sector despite signs of recovery in the wider market.
ex.zh: 尽管大盘出现复苏迹象，投资者对科技板块仍持谨慎态度。

ex.en: He was cautious about expressing his views at the meeting, fearing they might offend senior colleagues.
ex.zh: 他在会上谨言慎行，担心自己的观点可能冒犯资深同事。

senses: n. 细心,谨小慎微,慎重,小心,警惕

ex.en: His natural cautiousness prevented him from investing in the risky venture that later bankrupted many of his colleagues.
ex.zh: 他天生的谨慎使他避免投资那项后来让许多同事破产的高风险项目。

ex.en: Before tanks appeared, cavalry units provided armies with their main mobile striking force.
ex.zh: 在坦克出现之前，骑兵部队是军队主要的机动突击力量。

ex.en: Archaeologists discovered ancient paintings deep inside the cave, suggesting that humans occupied the site thousands of years ago.
ex.zh: 考古学家在洞穴深处发现了古代绘画，表明人类数千年前就曾在此居住。

ex.en: The report's optimistic conclusions come with an important caveat: the sample was drawn from a single region.
ex.zh: 报告的乐观结论有一个重要限制条件：样本仅取自单一地区。

ex.en: Please cc the finance department when you send the invoice, so the payment can be processed quickly.
ex.zh: 发送发票时请抄送财务部，以便尽快处理付款。

ex.en: Although streaming dominates the market, a small band of collectors still buys CDs for the sound quality.
ex.zh: 尽管流媒体主导市场，仍有一小批收藏者出于音质考虑购买CD。

ex.en: Lizards conceal themselves among fallen leaves to escape the sharp eyes of hawks.
ex.zh: 蜥蜴把自己藏进落叶之中，躲避老鹰锐利的目光。

senses: vt./vi. 停止，终止，结束: The commander ordered his troops to ~ fire. 指挥官命令他的队伍停止射击。
cease.usage: cease指终止正在存在或继续进行的事物；而halt指暂停中止中步子，常指两栖军，破介，阻延。；v.终止，结束；发音类似"息事"→息事宁人，"停止"战争→停止；索引p404

ex.en: The commander ordered his troops to cease fire. 指挥官命令他的队伍停止射击。
ex.zh: 指挥官命令他的队伍停止射击。

ex.en: There will eventually come a day when The New York Times ceases to publish stories on newsprint.
ex.zh: 总有一天，《纽约时报》会停止在报纸上发表报道。

ex.en: The ceasefire was announced at midnight, but gunfire continued along the northern edge of the city.
ex.zh: 停火协议于午夜宣布，但城市北部边缘仍有枪声。

ex.en: The ceaseless noise of the motorway finally persuaded the family to move.
ex.zh: 高速公路上永不停歇的噪音最终促使这家人搬走。

ex.en: The board voted to proceed with the merger despite objections from two senior directors.
ex.zh: 尽管两位资深董事反对，董事会仍投票决定继续推进并购。

senses: n. [C] 天花板；最高限度；最大飞行高度

ex.en: The government imposed a ceiling on rents to protect tenants from sudden increases during the housing shortage.
ex.zh: 政府对租金设定了上限，以保护租户免受住房短缺期间租金突然上涨的影响。

ex.en: The train accelerates smoothly to its top speed of three hundred kilometres an hour.
ex.zh: 列车平稳加速至每小时三百公里的最高速度。

senses: vt. ①庆祝：We held a party to ~ the anniversary of the founding of the PRC. 我们开会庆祝中华人民共和国成立的纪念日。

ex.en: The whole nation gathered in the streets to celebrate the anniversary of its independence with music and fireworks.
ex.zh: 全国人民聚集在街头，以音乐和烟花庆祝独立纪念日。

ex.en: The festival began as a small family celebration but has grown into a major cultural event attracting tourists worldwide.
ex.zh: 这个节日起初只是一次小小的家庭庆祝活动，如今已发展成吸引全球游客的重大文化活动。

senses: n. 名人，名流；名望，名誉；著名
celebrity.usage: n.名声，名望；名人，明 星；动词形式celebrate是“庆祝；赞美”→赞美的人→名人；索引p404

ex.en: He became something of a celebrity in his home town.
ex.zh: 他成为家乡一位小有名气的人。

ex.en: Of course, the image of parenthood that celebrity magazines like US Weekly and People present is hugely unrealistic, especially when the parents are single mothers like Bullock.
ex.zh: 当然，在《美国周刊》与《人物》等名人杂志上的家长形象是非常不切实际的，尤其当家长是像布洛克这样的单身母亲时更是如此。

ex.en: Celebrity endorsements can boost sales, but a single scandal may destroy the brand.
ex.zh: 名人代言能提升销量，但一桩丑闻就可能毁掉整个品牌。

ex.en: Social media has allowed ordinary people to achieve a form of celebrity without traditional gatekeepers.
ex.zh: 社交媒体让普通人无需传统守门人也能获得某种名气。

senses: n. 细胞；牢房；电池；移动电话；秘密活动小组
n. ①单人牢房：The prison has hundreds of ~s. 监狱里有数百间牢房。

ex.en: Cancer begins when a single cell divides uncontrollably.
ex.zh: 癌症始于单个细胞不受控制地分裂。

ex.en: Prisoners spent up to twenty-three hours a day in their cells.
ex.zh: 囚犯每天在牢房里要待上长达二十三小时。

ex.en: Scientists have developed a new fuel cell that stores energy more efficiently.
ex.zh: 科学家开发出一种储存能量效率更高的新燃料电池。

senses: n. 地窖，地下室：The worker went into the ~ to get a bottle of wine. 工人走进地窖取一瓶酒。

ex.en: The old wine bottles were stored in a damp cellar beneath the house, where the temperature stayed constant.
ex.zh: 旧酒瓶存放在房子下面潮湿的地窖里，那里温度保持恒定。

senses: n. 电影;(旧时用于制作电影胶片的)赛璐珞

ex.en: Many early films shot on celluloid have decayed because the material is highly flammable and unstable.
ex.zh: 许多用赛璐珞胶片拍摄的早期电影已经损毁，因为这种材料极易燃烧且不稳定。

senses: n. 水泥；胶合剂，胶接剂
cement.usage: 发音类似“塞门它”→门柱下塞些“水泥”固定。；索引p404

ex.en: They could cement the status quo of peer-reviewed research.
ex.zh: 它们会使同行评审研究的现状停滞不前。

ex.en: The trade treaty cemented close ties between the two partners.
ex.zh: 该贸易条约巩固了两个伙伴之间的密切关系。

ex.en: Cement production accounts for a significant share of global carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 水泥生产在全球碳排放中占相当大的比重。

ex.en: A shared interest in music cemented their friendship during university.
ex.zh: 对音乐的共同兴趣在大学期间巩固了他们的友谊。

ex.en: The cemetery on the hill dates from the twelfth century and contains some remarkable stone carvings.
ex.zh: 山上的墓园始建于十二世纪，存有一些了不起的石雕。

ex.en: According to the latest census, the town's population has fallen by a tenth in a decade.
ex.zh: 根据最新人口普查，该镇人口十年间减少了十分之一。

senses: n. 审查,检查,审查制度

ex.en: Writers of the period developed subtle ways of evading censorship while still criticizing the government.
ex.zh: 那个时期的作家发展出含蓄曲折的手法，既规避审查又不放弃对政府的批评。

senses: n. 人口普查，人口调查：The country conducts a national ~ every ten years. 该国每十年进行一次全国人口普查。
n. 人口普查，人口调查
n. 人口普查；(官方的)统计
census.usage: n.（官方的）统计，人口普查；索引p404

ex.en: Census is beneficial to ordinary citizens and the nation.
ex.zh: 人口普查利国利民。

ex.en: According to the latest census, the proportion of elderly citizens has risen sharply over the past decade.
ex.zh: 根据最新的人口普查，老年人口比例在过去十年中急剧上升。

ex.en: The national census, conducted every ten years, helps planners decide where to build schools and hospitals.
ex.zh: 每十年进行一次的全国人口普查帮助规划者决定在哪里修建学校和医院。

senses: n. ①分，分币：The pen costs 50 ~s. 这支钢笔值50分。
②(价值、意义的)百分之一：per ~ 百分之……

ex.en: The council approved the proposal by a margin of sixty per cent, reflecting broad public support for the plan.
ex.zh: 委员会以百分之六十的优势通过了该提案，反映出公众对该计划的广泛支持。

center.usage: 亦拼作centre；n.中间，中心点；活动中心； 关注点 v.把……放在中央；以……为中 心

ex.en: The new research center will focus on renewable energy, drawing experts from universities across the country.
ex.zh: 新的研究中心将专注于可再生能源，吸引来自全国各地大学的专家。

centerpiece.usage: 组合词:center(中心)+piece(零件，部件)→中心的零件→核心；索引p404

ex.en: He said that manufactures of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign, the centerpiece of government efforts to boost healthy eating and fitness.
ex.zh: 他说，薯片和糖果制造商可以在“为生命而改变”运动中发挥核心作用，该运动是政府促进健康饮食和身体健康的核心举措。

senses: adj. ①摄氏温度计的，百分度的：Water freezes at 0 degrees ~. 水在摄氏零度结冰。
n. 摄氏温度计,百分度
centigrade.usage: centi(百分之一)+grade(度)→百分度;亦作Celsius ['selsiəs]

ex.en: Average summer temperatures in the region now exceed thirty-five degrees centigrade, placing serious stress on the power grid.
ex.zh: 该地区夏季平均气温现已超过三十五摄氏度，给电网带来了严重压力。

senses: n. 厘米，公分：The line is 5 ~s long. 这条线长5厘米。
centimeter.usage: centi(百分之一)+meter(米)→百分之一米→厘米;亦拼作centimetre

ex.en: The gap between the two plates was less than one centimeter, yet the instrument detected it immediately.
ex.zh: 两块板之间的缝隙不到一厘米，但仪器立刻检测到了它。

senses: adj. ①中心的，中央的：~ heating 中央供暖 / the ~ government 中央政府
②主要的，最重要的：the ~ aim of the policy 政策的主要目标
③中枢的：the ~ nervous system 中枢神经系统

phrases.p: a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge
phrases.m: 获取学术地位和产出科学知识的首要因素

ex.en: Trust is central to any successful working relationship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何成功合作关系的关键。

ex.en: The central government has promised increased funding for rural schools.
ex.zh: 中央政府承诺增加对农村学校的拨款。

ex.en: They chose an apartment in a central location close to offices and universities.
ex.zh: 他们选择了一套位于市中心、邻近写字楼和大学的公寓。

ex.en: The centralization of decision-making in the ministry has slowed the local authorities' response to emergencies.
ex.zh: 决策权向部委集中拖慢了地方当局对紧急情况的反应。

phrases.p: the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

ex.en: The city centre has been transformed over the past decade, with old warehouses converted into apartments and galleries.
ex.zh: 十年来市中心面貌焕然一新，旧仓库被改造成公寓和画廊。

ex.en: Most of the city's theatres and galleries cluster around the historic centre.
ex.zh: 这座城市的大多数剧院和美术馆都聚集在历史中心区周围。

senses: a. 心态平和的，有自制力的；以……为中心的

ex.en: The new curriculum is designed to be learner-centred, encouraging students to set their own goals.
ex.zh: 新课程的设计以学习者为中心，鼓励学生设定自己的目标。

ex.en: The centrepiece of the government's housing plan is a levy on empty properties.
ex.zh: 政府住房计划的核心内容是对空置房产征税。

senses: n. 世纪，百年：the 21st ~ 21世纪 / the last ~ of the second millennium 第二个千年的最后一个世纪

ex.en: Over the last century, life expectancy has risen dramatically, posing new challenges for pension systems worldwide.
ex.zh: 在过去的一个世纪里，预期寿命大幅提高，给世界各地的养老金制度带来了新的挑战。

senses: n. ①(常用复数)谷类植物，谷物：~ crops 谷类作物
②(常用复数)(用作早餐的)谷类食物，麦片粥：a bowl of ~ 一碗麦片粥
adj. 谷类的,谷类制成的

ex.en: Breakfast cereals marketed to children often contain far more sugar than parents realize, according to a recent survey.
ex.zh: 最近一项调查显示，面向儿童销售的早餐麦片所含糖分往往远超家长们的想象。

senses: adj. 礼仪的,礼节的,用于礼仪的

ex.en: The president's role in the treaty signing was largely ceremonial.
ex.zh: 总统在条约签署中的作用在很大程度上只是礼仪性的。

ex.en: Guards wear elaborate ceremonial dress during state occasions.
ex.zh: 国家庆典期间，卫兵身着华丽的礼仪服装。

ex.en: The tribe preserved its ceremonial dances despite decades of outside pressure.
ex.zh: 尽管数十年来受到外部压力，这个部落仍保留着其仪式舞蹈。

senses: n. ①典礼，仪式：the opening ~ 开幕式 / the closing ~ 闭幕式
②礼节，礼仪：There is no need for ~ between friends. 朋友之间不拘礼节。
n. 典礼，仪式；礼节，礼仪
ceremony.usage: ritual 的近义词。；ce（发音类似“塞”）+re+mony（形似money“钱”）→塞钱→很多“典礼”上长辈给晚辈塞钱祝贺→典礼，仪式。

ex.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the main hall on Friday.
ex.zh: 毕业典礼将于周五在大礼堂举行。

ex.en: The wedding ceremony followed traditions passed down for generations.
ex.zh: 婚礼遵循了世代相传的传统。

ex.en: With great ceremony, the mayor cut the ribbon to open the new bridge.
ex.zh: 市长举行了隆重的仪式，为新大桥落成剪彩。

senses: adj. ①确凿的，无疑的，肯定的：The evidence is ~. 证据确凿。/ It is ~ that he will come. 他肯定会来。
②某一，某种，一些(作定语)：A ~ Mr. Smith called you. 有位史密斯先生给你打过电话。
certain.usage: certain 指有客观依据的确信；sure 侧重主观上的确信；definite 指明确的、肯定的。；adj.必然的；确定的；某个 pron.某些

ex.en: It is certain that remote work will reshape city planning.
ex.zh: 可以肯定的是，远程办公将重塑城市规划。

ex.en: Certain words carry different meanings in academic and everyday contexts.
ex.zh: 某些词在学术语境和日常语境中含义不同。

ex.en: She felt certain that the interview had gone badly, yet she was offered the job.
ex.zh: 她确信面试表现糟糕，却得到了这份工作。

ex.en: The evidence is certainly suggestive, but further experiments will be needed before any firm conclusion can be drawn.
ex.zh: 这些证据确实具有启发性，但在得出明确结论之前还需要进一步的实验。

certainty.usage: 记：cert（确信）+ain+-ty（名词后缀）→确信；n.确实，确定性；必然的事

ex.en: No one can predict with certainty how the climate will respond to cuts in emissions.
ex.zh: 没有人能确定地预测气候会对减排作何反应。

ex.en: In an uncertain job market, many graduates seek the certainty of public-sector employment.
ex.zh: 在不确定的就业市场中，许多毕业生寻求公共部门工作的确定性。

ex.en: The report replaces earlier guesswork with statistical certainty.
ex.zh: 该报告用统计学上的确定性取代了先前的猜测。

senses: n. ①证书，证明书：a birth ~ 出生证明 / a marriage ~ 结婚证
n. 证明，证明书；文凭；结业证书
v. 发给结业证书；（尤指）发给职业培训证书
certificate.usage: 记：cert（确信）+i+-ficate（做）→使人确信某人有能力做某事的凭证→证明；拓展：a birth/marriage/death certificate 出生/结婚/死亡证明；索引p404

ex.en: She showed her certificate of insurance.
ex.zh: 她出示了她的保险证明。

ex.en: Applicants must hold a recognised certificate in English proficiency.
ex.zh: 申请者必须持有认可的英语水平证书。

ex.en: He was awarded a certificate for completing the vocational training programme.
ex.zh: 他因完成职业培训课程而获得了证书。

ex.en: A birth certificate is required when a child is enrolled in school.
ex.zh: 儿童办理入学手续时需要出生证明。

ex.en: The school's certification as an examination centre was suspended pending an official inquiry.
ex.zh: 在官方调查结束之前，该校作为考试中心的认证被暂停。

senses: v. 证明，证实；颁发（或授予）专业合格证书
vt. 证明，证实；发证书（或执照）给…

ex.en: He handed her a piece of paper certifying (that) she was in good health.
ex.zh: 他递给她一份证明其健康状况良好的文件。

ex.en: The agency certifies that the building meets modern earthquake standards.
ex.zh: 该机构证明这座建筑符合现代抗震标准。

ex.en: Teachers must be certified before they can work in public schools.
ex.zh: 教师必须取得资格证书方可在公立学校任教。

ex.en: The pattern reported here is consistent with earlier field studies (cf. the surveys discussed in Chapter Two).
ex.zh: 本文报告的模式与早先的野外研究一致（参见第二章讨论的调查）。

senses: n. ①链条，链子，锁链：The dog was tied with a ~. 狗被链子拴着。
②(常与of连用)一连串，一系列，连锁：a ~ of events 一连串的事件 / ~ reaction 连锁反应

ex.en: The supermarket chain announced plans to open fifty new stores, creating thousands of jobs across the region.
ex.zh: 这家连锁超市宣布计划开设五十家新店，将在该地区创造数千个就业岗位。

ex.en: She was elected chair of the committee after years of devoted service to the organization.
ex.zh: 在多年为该组织尽职服务后，她当选为委员会主席。

senses: n. ①主席，议长，董事长，会长：the ~ of the board 董事长
②(委员会的)委员长，主任委员

ex.en: The chairman opened the meeting by summarising last year's performance.
ex.zh: 董事长在会议开始时总结了去年的业绩。

ex.en: She was appointed chairman of the inquiry into the banking scandal.
ex.zh: 她被任命为银行业丑闻调查委员会的主席。

ex.en: Under the new chairman, the company shifted its focus to green technology.
ex.zh: 在新董事长的领导下，公司将重心转向了绿色技术。

senses: n. 主席,委员长,董事长
chairmanchairwomanchairperson.usage: 助记:chair(主席席位)+man(人)→坐在主席席位的人→主席

ex.en: The chairman reminded members that only written amendments could be put to the vote.
ex.zh: 主席提醒各位成员，只有书面修正案才能付诸表决。

ex.en: Teachers once wrote every lesson on the board with chalk, a practice that digital screens have largely replaced.
ex.zh: 教师们曾用粉笔在黑板上写满每一课的内容，这一做法如今已基本被数字屏幕取代。

challenge.usage: 派生:challenging adj.挑战性的;令人深思的；发音类似“采灵芝”→让你采灵芝，这难道不是一个巨大的“挑战”吗；challenge sb to do sth 激某人做某事；challenging adj. 有挑战性的。；真题词组:management challenges管理方面的挑战；索引p404

ex.en: The non-intrusive delivery of the marketing messages in a way that is sensitive to the needs of the target customer is one of the critical challenges to the digital marketer.
ex.zh: 以一种对目标客户需求敏感的方式,非侵入性地传递营销信息是数字营销人员面临的关键挑战之一。

ex.en: We might then begin to solve our immigration challenges.
ex.zh: 然后我们可能会开始解决我们在移民方面所面临的挑战。

ex.en: The new policy faces a legal challenge.
ex.zh: 新政策面临法律挑战。

ex.en: Instead, the company has done precisely what it had long promised it would not: challenge the constitutionality of Vermont's rules in the federal court, as part of a desperate effort to keep its Vermont Yankee nuclear power plant running.
ex.zh: 相反，该公司恰恰做了它曾长久承诺不会去做的事情：在联邦法庭质疑佛蒙特州法规是否符合宪法，这是它竭力想维护佛蒙特扬基核电站的运行所做的努力之一。

senses: n. ①(旧时)房间，寝室：The king retired to his ~. 国王回到寝宫。
②议院：the Upper Chamber (英国)上议院
③(动植物体内的)腔，室：four ~s of the heart 心脏四个腔室

ex.en: The bill was approved by the lower chamber of parliament last night.
ex.zh: 该法案昨晚获得了议会下院的批准。

ex.en: The tomb contained a burial chamber decorated with ancient paintings.
ex.zh: 这座古墓内有一个饰有古代壁画的墓室。

ex.en: The engine draws fuel into the combustion chamber in milliseconds.
ex.zh: 发动机在几毫秒内将燃油吸入燃烧室。

ex.en: Champagne, once a drink reserved for royal courts, is now produced and consumed on a truly global scale.
ex.zh: 香槟曾是宫廷专属的饮品，如今已在真正全球化的范围内生产和消费。

champion.usage: 派生championship n.冠军称号;锦标赛

ex.en: After three years, he became the champion!
ex.zh: 三年后，他成了冠军！

ex.en: She championed the rights of part-time workers throughout her career.
ex.zh: 她在整个职业生涯中一直捍卫兼职工人的权利。

ex.en: The former tennis champion now coaches young players in his hometown.
ex.zh: 这位前网球冠军如今在家乡执教年轻球员。

chance.usage: chance 侧重偶然性或可能性；opportunity 侧重有利时机；possibility 侧重客观可能性的大小。；life chances人生机遇；索引p404

ex.en: Students from poor families rarely get the chance to attend top universities.
ex.zh: 贫困家庭的学生很少有机会进入顶尖大学。

ex.en: There is a strong chance that the new drug will reach the market next year.
ex.zh: 这种新药很有可能在明年上市。

ex.en: The discovery happened by chance while researchers were studying a different problem.
ex.zh: 这项发现是研究者在研究另一个问题时偶然获得的。

senses: n. ①(德国、奥地利的)总理：The German ~ visited China. 德国总理访问了中国。
②(英国的)大臣，首相(旧用法)
③(某些美国大学的)校长，(英国大学的)名誉校长
chancellor.usage: n.财政大臣；总理；校长；法 官；索引p404

ex.en: The German chancellor promised closer cooperation with its European partners.
ex.zh: 德国总理承诺与欧洲伙伴开展更紧密的合作。

ex.en: The chancellor announced cuts to public spending in the autumn statement.
ex.zh: 财政大臣在秋季预算声明中宣布削减公共开支。

ex.en: As chancellor of the university, he attends ceremonies but takes no part in daily management.
ex.zh: 作为这所大学的名誉校长，他出席典礼但不参与日常管理。

ex.en: A crystal chandelier hung in the ballroom, scattering light across the polished floor.
ex.zh: 一盏水晶吊灯悬在舞厅里，把光洒在光可鉴人的地板上。

ex.en: Cheap technologies bring about revolutionary change.
ex.zh: 廉价的技术带来革命性的变化。

ex.en: Climate change threatens coastal cities with rising sea levels.
ex.zh: 气候变化导致海平面上升，威胁着沿海城市。

ex.en: Nothing will change unless consumers demand safer products.
ex.zh: 除非消费者要求更安全的产品，否则什么都不会改变。

channel.usage: chann(=cane 茎，管)+el→管状物→渠道；n.频道，途径；渠道；沟渠 v.输送，传送

ex.en: Social media has become an important channel for companies to reach customers.
ex.zh: 社交媒体已成为企业触达客户的重要渠道。

ex.en: The shipping channel must be dredged regularly to keep large vessels moving.
ex.zh: 航道必须定期疏浚，以便大型船只通行。

ex.en: Viewers are abandoning traditional channels in favour of online platforms.
ex.zh: 观众正在放弃传统电视频道，转向在线平台。

senses: n. ①(有节奏地、重复地喊的)口号：The crowd broke into ~s of "More jobs!" 人群突然喊起要有更多工作的口号。
②圣歌，赞美诗(v.) vt. ③反复(有节奏)地喊叫(口号等)：The demonstrators ~ed slogans. 示威者反复喊口号。

ex.en: Supporters of the bill gathered outside the hall, their chant growing louder as the debate continued inside.
ex.zh: 该法案的支持者聚集在大厅外，随着里面的辩论继续，他们的呼喊声越来越大。

senses: n. 1混乱，紊乱(u)：The country was in ~ after the war. 战后该国陷入混乱。
n. 混乱，紊乱(u): After the flooding, the city was in ~ for weeks. 洪水过后，城市陷入数周的混乱。
chaos.usage: 派生chaotic adj.混乱的,紊乱的；chao（吵）+s（死）→家里每天都吵死了→混乱。；索引p404

ex.en: Beethoven's music tends to move from chaos to order.
ex.zh: 贝多芬的音乐往往是从混乱走向秩序。

ex.en: Beethoven's music tends to move from chaos to order as if order were an imperative of human existence.
ex.zh: 贝多芬的音乐倾向于从嘈杂无序发展为井然有序，仿佛秩序是人类存在的一个至关重要的因素。

ex.en: The finance minister's sudden resignation threw the markets into chaos.
ex.zh: 财政部长的突然辞职使市场陷入混乱。

ex.en: Without clear rules, the shared workspace descended into chaos within a week.
ex.zh: 没有明确的规则，共用办公区在一周之内便陷入混乱。

ex.en: Traffic in the old town becomes chaotic during rush hour, as narrow streets were never designed for modern vehicles.
ex.zh: 上下班高峰期间老城区的交通变得混乱不堪，因为狭窄的街道从来不是为现代车辆设计的。

ex.en: The wedding was held in a small stone chapel beside the river.
ex.zh: 婚礼在河边一座小石头礼拜堂里举行。

senses: n. (书的)章，回，篇：the first ~ of the book 书的第一章
n. (书的)章，回：the first ~ of the book 书的第一章

ex.en: The author devotes an entire chapter to the economic forces that shaped the industrial revolution.
ex.zh: 作者用整整一章的篇幅论述了塑造工业革命的经济力量。

character.usage: 同义:nature(特性)；n.性格；特色，特征；人物， 角色；名誉，名声；字符；n.性格；特点；角色；名誉；n.特征例为2015年翻译；索引p404

ex.en: The author's characters are drawn from real life. 作者笔下的人物来源于现实生活。
ex.zh: 作者笔下的人物来源于现实生活。

ex.en: The minor characters in the novel provide a lot of the humour.
ex.zh: 小说中的那些小角色制造了很多幽默。

ex.en: But the result was a new social pattern which, although it resembled European society in many ways, had a character that was distinctly American.
ex.zh: 但其结果却产生了一个全新的社会模式，尽管它在许多方面与欧洲社会类似，但却有着显著美国特征。
